categories.main_business_segments: Nantong JiangTian Chemical Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, production, and sales of high-end specialty fine chemicals derived from methanol downstream processing. Its main products include granular paraformaldehyde, high-concentration formaldehyde, ultra-high purity chloromethane, 1,3,5-triallyl hexahydro-s-triazine, and superabsorbent polymers (SAP). The company recently expanded into the consumer chemical sector through the acquisition of San Daya Fine Chemicals, adding high absorbency resin products used in hygiene products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced catalytic and chemical synthesis technologies for producing paraformaldehyde, formaldehyde, chloromethane, and triazine derivatives, supported by numerous patented technologies related to catalyst systems, process optimization, and emission control. It emphasizes green chemistry principles, process optimization for energy efficiency, and waste reduction. Production follows ISO9001 and ISO14001 standards with integrated quality, environmental, and safety management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in synthetic resins, adhesives, concrete additives, pesticides, pharmaceuticals, textiles, electronics, and hygiene products sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with exports accounting for about 19% of revenue, focusing on industrial and consumer chemical applications. Major customers include several large industrial clients, with the top five customers accounting for approximately 37% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, headquartered in Nantong Economic and Technological Development Zone, Jiangsu Province. It also has a growing export business serving overseas markets, contributing nearly 20% of total revenue. The company benefits from its location in a nationally recognized chemical industrial park with advanced infrastructure and logistics.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nantong JiangTian Chemical operates mainly in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, producing specialty fine chemicals from methanol and other raw materials. It sources key raw materials like methanol through long-term contracts and supplies intermediate and specialty chemicals to downstream industrial and consumer product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in catalyst activity enhancement, environmental protection technologies, product diversification, and process optimization. It collaborates with Zhejiang University on applied research to develop new triazine derivatives and explore new application fields. The strategic acquisition of San Daya Fine Chemicals aims to expand into superabsorbent polymers and consumer chemical markets. Emphasis is placed on green, intelligent manufacturing and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products to industrial and consumer customers. The company uses a direct sales model with some customers under supply framework agreements. Revenue streams include product sales of specialty chemicals and fine chemicals, with a small portion from chemical trading and technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic producer of methanol downstream specialty chemicals with a focus on import substitution and high-quality products. It competes in markets for paraformaldehyde, formaldehyde, triazine derivatives, and superabsorbent polymers. It holds national-level 'specialized and innovative' enterprise status and provincial technology center recognition, indicating strong competitive positioning in China’s fine chemical industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 688 million, a slight decrease of 2.92% from the previous year, while net profit attributable to shareholders surged by 334% to RMB 297.7 million, mainly due to negative goodwill from the acquisition of San Daya. Total assets nearly doubled to RMB 2.2 billion, reflecting significant investment and expansion. The company maintains a strong equity base with a return on equity of 36.11%. Cash flow from operations declined significantly due to acquisition-related payments and increased costs.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, customization capabilities, and technological innovation to meet diverse customer needs. Its granular paraformaldehyde offers superior solubility, safety, and reduced occupational hazards compared to competitors. The integration of new product lines like superabsorbent polymers broadens application fields and customer base, enhancing risk resilience. Commitment to green manufacturing, digital transformation, and strong R&D partnerships further differentiate its offerings in the fine chemical market.
